player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the task by issuing "DONE" while in the Sauna, failing to realize that the Gallery still had an unvisited direction (east) available. My mistake was assuming that returning to a previously visited room meant all rooms were explored, without checking if that room offered a path to a new area. Next time, I will maintain a mental map of visited rooms and, crucially, track which directions have been attempted from each room. I will only issue "DONE" when I am in a room where all available directions lead to rooms I have already visited and all directions from those rooms have also been exhausted. Specifically, upon returning to the Gallery, I must attempt the remaining "east" direction before considering the task complete.
